name: La Ceiba
registryCustodian: Alcaldía Municipal de La Ceiba, Departamento de Catastro
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Spanish first-party discovery found the municipal La Ceiba cadastral transparency page, SINIT's 0101 La Ceiba module, IGN cartography information, and SINAP. The municipal page listed cadastral reports and procedures; SINIT exposed thematic maps. No anonymous La Ceiba parcel-polygon response or stable native parcel identity was verified. SINAP ArcGIS requests were blocked or unrelated to La Ceiba and were not treated as absence.
scopeLimits: No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe La Ceiba parcel geometry and native identity were verified.
The municipal transparency page is evidence of a local cadastre custodian and published administrative information, not evidence of an open parcel-feature API.
SINIT maps are thematic municipal layers and were not treated as cadastral parcels.
SINAP ArcGIS indexed examples included municipal boundaries and a Nacaome cadastral annotation layer, but not a verified La Ceiba parcel layer.
The exact WUP point [15.7690158562588, -86.797312584364] was preserved and not shifted; no exact-point hit or absence conclusion was made.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, owner/address data, or unsafe fields were requested.
sourceSpecificFields: No parcel schema was obtained for La Ceiba. Indexed Nacaome metadata mentioned OBJECTID, FeatureID, TextString, GlobalID, and geometry fields, but this unrelated layer was not retained or mapped to La Ceiba.
qualification: Not qualified for runtime integration or admission; a serial reviewer would need to independently verify a La Ceiba parcel route, schema, CRS, native identifier, and safe geometry response.
uncertainty: A local cadastral institution is evidenced, but public parcel geometry availability, citywide coverage, update cadence, and adapter robustness remain unknown. A blocked request is not evidence of source absence.
